NoCrossTalk.description: Star graph preserving 8 bipartite patient-organ edges and removing all 6 organ-organ cross-talk edges

FlatReadout.description: Retains full 14-edge biology but replaces hierarchical organ-aware readout with flat mean pooling across all 5 nodes

RandomEdges.description: Erdos-Renyi random digraph G(5, 14) sampling 14 directed edge types uniformly at random from 20 possible non-self directed pairs

HomoGNN.description: Collapses heterogeneous node and relation types into a homogeneous 5-node graph with uniform GCN message passing
